notablePrerequisites: Elves you control can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{G}.
description:
Activate any number of Elves you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{G}.
Each Elf tapped this way triggers, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Dionus from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dionus by paying {3}{G}, which enters the battlefield as a new object, thus granting a fresh instance of the ability to each Elf you control.
Repeat.
